scope: Character decisions ONLY, leave scene environment/camera to later calibrations

entries.decision: Reuse CesiumMan for hero plus nine procedural seat profiles
entries.userObservation: Pasajeros hechos de figuras geométricas prohibidas; poco convincentes
entries.symptom: Geometry spheres/cylinders build heads, eyes and torsos of supporting humans; manifest admits primitive visual deficiency
entries.fix: Consult reject registry before reusing seated-crowd family; select materially different body+face and rig; allow source-based fallback but never label final human quality approved

entries.decision: Clone CesiumMan skeleton 12x, recolor and add accessories
entries.userObservation: Movimiento fluido rescatable pero cara y skin raras; no identidad profesional
entries.symptom: Same technical GLB silhouette, pattern skin and proportional face cloned, not 12 independent characters
entries.fix: Forbid CesiumMan as new final visible human model; extract locomotion controller/clip concept independently with proven rig retarget or adapt motion logic

entries.userObservation: Personaje no integrado estéticamente, apariencia técnica
entries.symptom: Source explicitly cites same sample actor, no alternative considered
entries.fix: Require at least two visual family options and assign independent station-specific silhouette, wardrobe and facial representation

entries.userObservation: Personaje repetido, cuerpo/skin de prueba y fondo oscuro
entries.symptom: Same blue-green sample asset loaded directly, even if animation exists
entries.fix: Choose a distinct scientist mesh/wardrobe with source-permitted rig, do not conflate existing clip with actor quality
entries.motionSalvage: Walk cadence may be re-used when retarget proof exists

entries.decision: Two Quaternius-derived GLBs with same base morphology, recolored civilian assets
entries.userObservation: Personajes aún artificiales para primeros planos; rostros poco expresivos
entries.symptom: Actual rigged GLB, but color variation without face topology/expressions didn't satisfy closeup
entries.fix: Closeup-specific facial morphology/shape keys and actual acting pipeline before choosing assets; no substitution by two recolors
entries.motionSalvage: Motion rig not approved without closeup proof

entries.decision: Reuse original hand-authored contour/loft actor and portrait from V2
entries.userObservation: Cara y figura sin fidelidad humana profesional
entries.symptom: Hand-authored loft contours, technically not Box/Sphere/Cylinder, still insufficient facial art and no independent IK proof; stage trace repeated generic decisions
entries.fix: Do not treat 'no primitives' as enough; require purpose-built authored face+UV+closeup proof and source-specific decision trace

rootPatterns.mechanism: Existing source became default without checking human negative verdict and current role/shot distance
The same base model was copied with recolor or props, not new silhouette/facial source
Skinned GLB and count of characters satisfied source checks without user-level appearance/face test
Some workers explicitly documented poor source but did not choose alternative; others repeated generic decisions in all stages
CesiumMan model was reused because movement existed, importing unsuitable silhouette/skin too

principle: Assign failure to earliest causal stage with source path and trace refs; human visual report is independent of code verification. Do not claim screenshot binary stored.
